title: IfWorld: A Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Disciplinary Counterfactual Scenario Reasoning

contributions.purpose: 把模糊 what-if 命题转为可执行结构化场景
contributions.mechanism: 自动桥接框架:跨学科变量建模与指标对齐,编排并行领域专家(物理/生态/医学/经济等)
contributions.evaluation: 十命题上总分 89.5/100,居各基线之首
contributions.domain: 多智能体推理 / 反事实场景
contributions.source_quote: An automatic bridging framework from counterfactual propositions to executable scenarios, enabling cross-disciplinary variable modeling and metric alignment.

contributions.purpose: 跨域证据冲突的检测与仲裁
contributions.mechanism: detect–adjudicate–trace 机制 + 不确定性传播 + 先验一致性仲裁
contributions.evaluation: 消融(磁场坍缩场景)去冲突对齐 93.0→79.0,降幅最大
contributions.source_quote: A detect-adjudicate-trace mechanism for cross-domain evidence conflicts that incorporates uncertainty propagation and prior-consistency-aware adjudication.

contributions.purpose: 多主题评测协议验证优越性
contributions.mechanism: LLM-as-Judge(doubao-1.6-thinking,温度0)对 single/tree/debate 逐点打分
contributions.evaluation: Decisionability 13.6 vs 9.8/11.8/10.5;但 10 任务中 2 项落后(O2 rose 79 vs tree 89;Gravity×10 90 vs debate 92)
contributions.source_quote: a multi-topic evaluation protocol demonstrating that IFWORLD outperforms mainstream reasoning and multi-agent baselines.

self_declared_provenance.quote: In comparison with single-agent, tree-search, and debate-style workflows, IFWORLD yields clearer cross-domain reasoning chains, more explicit uncertainty characterization, and decision-ready scenario structures.

notes: trade-off/负结果:10 任务中 2 项被基线超越(oxygen levels rose 79 vs Tree 89;Gravity×10 90 vs Debate 92)。方法疑点:评测者 doubao-1.6-thinking 与被测系统同用 doubao 家族(doubao-1.6-flash),LLM-as-judge 存在同族自偏好风险;仅 10 个命题、单次(single-shot)无外部检索,样本量小。质量瑕疵:正文出现断裂交叉引用 'Table ??'(LaTeX 未解析);消融 Table 3 全模型 93.0 与主表 Table 1 宏均 89.5 口径/设置不一致。3 条编号贡献。
